description: Batched differentiable PyTorch gravitational waveform models. Full LAL parity is not achieved; independent coverage and inherited calibration provenance remain incomplete.

precessing_and_hm_tolerance.role: diagnostic reference only; does not replace direct complex, norm, or mismatch gates

global_conventions.polarizations: Complex Fourier strain h_plus(f) and h_cross(f) in physical geometric units (G/c^2 / distance)
global_conventions.time_translation: Model-specific. Explicit Fourier time shifts generally use exp(-2*pi*i*f*tc); the default legacy NSBH gauge retains a positive time slope anchored at f_ref. See each model and the independent audit.
global_conventions.reference_phasing: Model-specific reference phases are tested only for the declared configurations; unresolved frame and phase conventions are documented in the independent audit.

TaylorF2_HM.name: TaylorF2_HM
TaylorF2_HM.notes: The external TaylorF2 case checks only (2,2); higher modes have no independent full-waveform reference in this suite. The native leading-order inventory now contains eight source-backed modes through l=4: (2,2), (2,1), (3,1), (3,2), (3,3), (4,2), (4,3), and (4,4). The available (4,1) and (5,5) time-domain expressions do not independently fix the native negative-m storage and SPA phase conventions, so those modes remain excluded. Higher-PN and spin-amplitude completeness remains unresolved.

IMRPhenomXP.name: IMRPhenomXP
IMRPhenomXP.frame_convention: Default MSA version 223, convention 1, final_spin_mod=3; supported phi0=0 requests use the clean MSA helper. Legacy geometry remains for nonzero phi0; unsupported guard rows use explicit fallback.
IMRPhenomXP.notes: Frozen checkpoint-3 public catalog and holdout rows pass for the clean supported path (maximum polarization complex relative L2 7.36e-14 catalog and 3.52e-14 holdout; detector projection errors are 3.02e-7 and 3.40e-7). The production default is MSA version 223 with convention=1 and final_spin_mod=3; supported phi0=0 requests use the clean helper. This is frozen-case evidence, not a parameter-domain certificate: convention-1 exact-aligned and zero-spin probes remain ~3e-5, tiny in-plane probes ~0.0073, unsupported guard rows use explicit fallback, and nonzero phi0 retains legacy geometry. XPHM remains unresolved/failing.

primary_references.citation: Pratten et al. (2021), Phys. Rev. D 103, 104056

IMRPhenomXP.precession_domain: The clean MSA v223 helper supports declared phi0=0 requests with convention=1 and final_spin_mod=3. Unsupported guard rows use explicit fallback; nonzero phi0 retains legacy geometry. Passing frozen rows do not certify the full precession parameter domain.

IMRPhenomXHM.name: IMRPhenomXHM
IMRPhenomXHM.frame_convention: García-Quirós et al. (2020) spherical harmonic decomposition and collocation reconstruction
IMRPhenomXHM.notes: Uniform strict CPU FP64 gates apply to both polarizations and detector projections. Only the listed cases have been checked. See docs/reviews/2026-09-12-clean-room/summary.md for remaining numerical, model-definition and provenance gaps. Pass 11 independently verifies cancellation of the mode normalization in the 32 carrier mixing ratio; production regression added, waveform normalization unchanged. Pass 12 selects cubic intermediate amplitude in unconditional published parameter-veto regions. Absolute-amplitude thresholds and ordered conditional vetoes remain unresolved; no frozen parity metric changed. Pass 13 corrects the intermediate amplitude fit normalization to constant A0 and separates derivative-removal pole fallback from inner-value parameter vetoes with interval-wide selection. It uses published default phase nodes [1,2,3,4,6] with inherited p6 tables. Sparse-node switching and table phase-target preprocessing remain unresolved. Full waveform parity remains unachieved. Pass 14 applies the published absolute-value convention to odd-m inspiral and intermediate amplitude collocation targets; raw fit coefficients are unchanged. Independently evaluated author expressions check eight intermediate amplitude fits and the nonmixing p6 phase fits. Expression matches do not establish production fit selection or full calibration preprocessing. Ordered amplitude vetoes, complete root detection and sparse-node selection remain unresolved. Full waveform parity remains unachieved. Pass 15 adds partial-node quartics, conditional high-q node removal, and numerical stationary-point denominator checks with selected value-only fallback. Four-point A/A0 monotonicity is an explicit interpretation of an underspecified rule; numeric amplitude threshold units remain unresolved and inactive. Raw fits and acceptance gates are unchanged. Strict passing counts did not increase and several independent XHM/XPHM waveform errors worsened. Sparse-node selection and calibration metadata remain unresolved; full parity remains unachieved. Pass 17 archives and verifies the complete official intermediate phase-fit set. No runtime change was retained because the numeric amplitude-veto normalization, sparse phase dispatch, canonical high-q Lambda record, and printed 32 amplitude-cut denominator remain unresolved.

primary_references.citation: García-Quirós et al. (2020), Phys. Rev. D 102, 064002
Pratten et al. (2020), Phys. Rev. D 102, 064001

IMRPhenomNSBH.name: IMRPhenomNSBH
IMRPhenomNSBH.notes: The frozen catalog, holdout, and 22 expanded strict waveform regressions pass after clean phase-mass, remnant-spin and amplitude-branch corrections. The public-compatible tidal-frequency sign, small-tide boundary polynomial, ringdown window sign and mildly disruptive PN-window composition are documented in implementation-status.md. The underlying inherited PhenomD and remnant calibration provenance remains under review; these tests do not certify the full parameter domain.

IMRPhenomNSBH.phase_conventions: Default legacy affine gauge and positive reference-anchored time slope are preserved for compatibility. Explicit coalescence/reference-frequency conventions use the shared intrinsic PhenomD phase and negative Fourier time shift.

KerrRingdown.name: KerrRingdown
KerrRingdown.notes: The canonical (2,2), n=0 physical-energy waveform passes the frozen catalog and four expanded public TD-to-FD comparisons at the original 1e-6 tolerance. Its independent public reference uses SimBlackHoleRingdown and composite-Simpson Fourier integration. The angular series stopping rule and adaptive integration tolerance are inferred numerical compatibility conventions, not fitted calibration. Other listed modes and overtones do not inherit this full-waveform result.

primary_references.citation: Cook and Zalutskiy (2014), Phys. Rev. D 90, 124021
Gregory Cook, High Accuracy Data for the Gravitational Quasinormal Modes of Kerr Black Holes, v4
Berti, Cardoso, Will (2006), Phys. Rev. D 73, 064030

SEOBNR_ODE.name: SEOBNR_ODE
SEOBNR_ODE.notes: Uniform strict CPU FP64 gates apply to both polarizations and detector projections. Only the listed cases have been checked. See docs/reviews/2026-09-12-clean-room/summary.md for remaining numerical, model-definition and provenance gaps. Legacy v4/v5 aliases do not certify a calibrated model version. Pass 20 verifies the pre-NQC phase, remnant fits, NQC equations and C1 attachment as bounded components under explicit choices. Pass 21 wires the prototype default to refined peak plus NQC/C1 attachment when the peak resolves, retaining the legacy final-sample PhenomD fallback for under-resolved runs. assembly_model='seobnrv4_published' exposes the end-to-end published path and requires all five choices explicitly. The rerun strict diagnostic remains failed (polarization L2 1.0206987416256423; projection L2 1.0205836988469421); no LAL parity is claimed.

SEOBNRv4Published.conventions: Initial orbital phase zero; phic rotates h22 by exp(-2i*phic); tc sets NQC amplitude peak; finite Fourier sum uses exp(-2*pi*i*f*t). No taper. Target phase/time compatibility unresolved.
SEOBNRv4Published.numerical_limits: Discrete peak/stencil/sample-count selection; local quartic matching and linear earlier interpolation. Float64 preferred; finer step checks required. Two-input convergence is not a 1e-6 accuracy certificate.
SEOBNRv4Published.scope: Explicit experimental assembly; does not replace SEOBNR_ODE or certify SEOBNRv4/ROM. Required choices were frozen before binary probing.
